purpose: Bind the executable historical-packed-training versus corrected-padded-training sensitivity summary without turning the execution change into a randomized causal factor.
prospective_plan_status: The parent analysis protocol froze matched-normalized-stage descriptive rankings and optimizer-minus-AdamW deltas before the first corrected checkpoint existed.

visibility_at_implementation_freeze.corrected_checkpoint_state: Two active AdamW runs had written checkpoint-782 and were at step 982; no checkpoint tensor was read to design, tune, or test this implementation.

implementation_choices.matching: Match each optimizer, exact declared learning rate, and normalized retained stage from 20% through 100%; historical and corrected rows remain separate inputs and are never pooled.
implementation_choices.headline_aggregation: At each stage, take the arithmetic mean over all four declared learning rates within optimizer separately for each execution.
implementation_choices.optimizer_contrasts: For Muon and NorMuon separately, subtract the same-execution AdamW four-rate mean at each stage, then report corrected contrast minus historical contrast.
implementation_choices.ranking: Rank the three optimizer four-rate means descending at each stage. Exact ties receive average ranks; the displayed order breaks a tie alphabetically only for deterministic rendering.
implementation_choices.matched_run_rows: Also report all 60 exact optimizer-rate-stage pairs and corrected minus historical mean nDCG@10 for auditability; these differences are descriptive.
implementation_choices.inference: No confidence interval, p-value, or pooled causal estimate is computed from the two executions.

paper_only_amendment.reason: Rebind publication-only parent amendments and the paper-only dense discovery manifest. Matching, aggregation, ranking, output cardinalities, and claim boundary are unchanged.

claim_boundary: A ranking or optimizer-minus-AdamW change is execution-path sensitivity evidence. The historical and corrected checkpoints are not a newly randomized packing experiment, so this summary is not a causal estimate of packing and must not be pooled into corrected inference.
